intro1: I’m a creative director based in Mumbai. I began as a music journalist at Rock Street Journal in 2005, then moved into copywriting at Webchutney and Wunderman. I went on to lead creative at JWT and McCann, on brands such as Ford, Google and IKEA. In 2023, I co-founded Neon Owl Studios, where we make films and build brands.
intro2: These days, I’m moving towards marketing and strategy roles. Most recently, I built the website for satyaspeaks.co and devised its marketing and advertising strategy. I’m also the founder-editor of The Moto Globe, build small software tools, and shoot street photography with my trusty Fujifilm.

projects.title: Satya Speaks
projects.short: A new home for Satya Speaks: talks, courses, writings and a members’ community in one place. I built the site and planned how it reaches people.

story.t: Satya Speaks had outgrown its earlier website. It needed one place for talks, courses, writings and a members’ community, and a plan for bringing people to it.
I built the new website and devised the marketing and advertising strategy for its launch, across the newsletter, YouTube, Substack and Spotify.
Launched in November 2026 at satyaspeaks.co, with talks, courses, writings and a members’ community, and apps for Android and iOS. A launch promo film is in production.

projects.title: Gatefold
projects.short: A pitch and funding tool for creative professionals. One shareable link holds the whole project, with version history and funding built in.

story.t: Creative work is still pitched with tools built for corporate decks. A filmmaker builds slides, emails them around, and collects feedback through scattered texts and voice notes. There is no single source of truth, no version history, and no way to raise money without leaving the platform.

Every project gets one link. It holds eight required fields, from logline to budget range, up to eighteen optional sections, a horizontal “Flow” of images, video and sound that lets someone feel the project’s arc, every past version, and an optional funding section with direct payments.
Not a deck generator, a marketplace or a social feed. AI helps only when asked and never overwrites what a creator wrote.
A near-black canvas, two functional colours and three typefaces, built on Dieter Rams’ idea that nothing should be on it that isn’t doing a job.
In active development. Next.js, Supabase, Stripe and Razorpay, on Vercel.

projects.title: Lulu-fm
projects.short: A music discovery platform built from my own library: about 67,000 songs from my YouTube Music and Spotify likes and followed artists, in one player.

story.t: Years of listening, spread across two services. Lulu-fm brings it into one real library: every song I have liked and every artist I follow on YouTube Music and Spotify, about 67,000 tracks.
Illustrated scenes of Lulu, our cat, fill the screen while one small player at the bottom plays from both services.
Live, and shared on Instagram and X.

projects.title: Royal Enfield
projects.short: Six training films for Royal Enfield’s showroom sales and customer teams, told as scenes from the showroom floor.

story.t: A series for Royal Enfield’s sales and customer relations teams. Each film takes one part of the sale, from the test ride and decision-making and pricing to upselling and cross-selling, customer relations and a summary.
I directed the series and led the business development behind it, staging each lesson as a scene between customers and staff on the showroom floor.
The decision-making and pricing film is on Vimeo, and all six are on my YouTube channel.

projects.title: Rebel Foods
projects.short: A rap film for FAASOS’ #HungerSaver initiative, featuring Kaam Bhaari. Over a million views.

story.t: #HungerSaver is FAASOS’ initiative to give back to the thousands of underprivileged children in the city’s gullies who struggle to get a good meal.
The #HungerSaver (w)Rap, featuring Kaam Bhaari, shot on location in Juhu, Mumbai.
Over a million views and 21,000 likes on YouTube.

projects.title: Shunya
projects.short: Launch films for Shunya’s herbal infusion drinks, mixing live action with hyperrealistic animation.

story.t: Shunya was launching three new beverages, and the campaign needed films to introduce them.
The films mix live action with hyperrealistic animation.
I directed the films while at Digi Osmosis.

projects.title: OZiva
projects.short: Product films for OZiva’s protein and hair vitamins.

story.t: Product films for two of OZiva’s ranges: its protein and its hair vitamins.
I produced the films.
The films are on Vimeo.

projects.title: JW Marriott
projects.short: Films for JW Marriott’s Diwali campaign, “Handcrafted to Perfection”.

story.t: A set of Diwali films for JW Marriott, built around the line “Handcrafted to Perfection”.
I directed the films.
The films are on Vimeo.

projects.title: The Bloop Troop
projects.short: An award-winning animated short in which a barbarian, a master archer and a knight go to war against a fly. Directed by Ram Singh; I’m one of the writers.

story.t: A barbarian, a master archer and a knight are drawn into battle against a formidable fly, turning an age-old wish to win a war against a common pest into an epic, over-the-top conflict. Directed by Ram Singh at Pencillati Studios.
I’m one of the writers on the film. I worked on the concept and am credited as a copywriter.

Winner, Best Animated Short at the 24FPS International Animation Awards 2016. Winner, 2D Animated Short at the Delhi CG Animation Awards. Winner, Best Animated Short at IIACFF 2016. Nominated for Best Short Film at the Suzanne Awards 2016. Official selection at the Big Muddy Film Festival, the Beeston Film Festival and the International Motion Festival in Cyprus, all in 2016.
The film is on Vimeo, and the film’s own site is blooptroop.com.

projects.title: Far the Days Come
projects.short: A black-and-white animated short that follows fire from the tree that fell to the world it went on to burn. Directed by Ram Singh; I’m one of the writers. A Vimeo Staff Pick and winner of 2D Animated Short at the Delhi CG Animation Awards.

story.t: It begins with a tree that fell and the fire man discovered. From there the film follows what that fire turned into, from comfort to destruction, until, as its closing line puts it, the world has come a full circle. Directed by Ram Singh at Pencillati Studios, in black and white, running just under two minutes.
I’m one of the writers on the film, and I’m credited for the concept. Ram Singh directed it.
Vimeo Staff Pick. Winner, 2D Animated Short at the Delhi CG Animation Awards.
The film is on Vimeo. It also has an IMDb page and a Behance write-up.
